```{js zoom-jquery, echo = FALSE}
$(document).ready(function() {
    if (window.jQuery) {
        $('body').prepend('<div class="zoomDiv"><img src="" class="zoomImg"></div>');
        $('body').on('click', 'img:not(.zoomImg)', function() {
            $('.zoomImg').attr('src', $(this).attr('src')).css({width: '100%'});
            $('.zoomDiv').css({opacity: '1', width: 'auto', border: '1px solid white', borderRadius: '5px', position: 'fixed', top: '50%', left: '50%', marginRight: '-50%', transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)', boxShadow: '0px 0px 50px #888888', zIndex: '50', overflow: 'auto', maxHeight: '100%'});
        });
        $('body').on('click', 'img.zoomImg', function() {
            $('.zoomDiv').css({opacity: '0', width: '0%'});
        });
    }
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const titleText = document.querySelector("h1.title")?.textContent || "AMAP Report";
      const toc = document.getElementById("TOC");
      if (!toc) return;
      let header = toc.querySelector(".tocify-header");
      if (!header) { header = document.createElement("div"); header.className = "tocify-header"; toc.prepend(header); }
      header.textContent = titleText;
    });
});
```

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(DT)
library(stringr)
library(knitr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# ------------- GLOBAL VARIABLES -------------
# Lineage color palette — MTBC lineages + generic fallback
mtbc_colors <- c("L5"="#995200","L6"="#1eb040","A1"="#d1ae00","A4"="#ff9cdb","A2"="#8ef5c8",
                 "A3"="#73c2ff","L4"="#ff0000","L1"="#ff3091","L2"="#001aff","L3"="#8a0bd2",
                 "L7"="#fbff00","L8"="#ff9d00","L9"="#37ff30","L10"="#8fbda1","NA"="#808080")
# Will be extended dynamically with any lineages not in the MTBC palette
colors <- mtbc_colors

cog_names <- c("A"="A - RNA processing and modification","B"="B - Chromatin structure and dynamics",
  "C"="C - Energy production and conversion","D"="D - Cell cycle control, cell division",
  "E"="E - Amino acid transport and metabolism","F"="F - Nucleotide transport and metabolism",
  "G"="G - Carbohydrate transport and metabolism","H"="H - Coenzyme transport and metabolism",
  "I"="I - Lipid transport and metabolism","J"="J - Translation, ribosomal structure",
  "K"="K - Transcription","L"="L - Replication, recombination and repair",
  "M"="M - Cell wall/membrane/envelope biogenesis","N"="N - Cell motility",
  "O"="O - Post-translational modification, chaperones","P"="P - Inorganic ion transport",
  "Q"="Q - Secondary metabolites biosynthesis","R"="R - General function prediction only",
  "S"="S - Function unknown","T"="T - Signal transduction mechanisms",
  "U"="U - Intracellular trafficking, secretion","V"="V - Defense mechanisms",
  "W"="W - Extracellular structures","X"="X - Mobilome: prophages, transposons",
  "Y"="Y - Nuclear structure","Z"="Z - Cytoskeleton","NA"="None")

# ------------- HELPER FUNCTIONS -------------
process_id <- function(id) {
  id <- as.character(id)
  if (is.na(id) || id == "" || startsWith(id, "_")) {
    lineage <- "NA"
    genome <- ifelse(is.na(id) || id == "", NA_character_, sub("^_", "", id))
  } else {
    parts <- str_split(id, "_", n = 2)[[1]]
    lineage <- parts[1]
    genome <- ifelse(length(parts) > 1, parts[2], NA_character_)
  }
  return(c(lineage, genome))
}

make_dt <- function(df, fname = "table") {
  datatable(df, rownames = FALSE, extensions = 'Buttons',
    options = list(dom = 'Bfrtip', pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE,
      buttons = list('copy', list(extend='csv', filename=fname),
                     list(extend='excel', filename=fname), 'print'),
      initComplete = JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "$(this.api().table().header()).css({'background-color':'#3da68d','color':'#fff','font-size':'14px','font-family':'Roboto'});",
        "$(this.api().table().body()).css({'font-size':'13px','font-family':'Roboto'});",
        "}")),
    class = 'cell-border stripe')
}

generate_statistics_table <- function(data, case_value) {
  data_filtered <- data %>% filter(V1 == case_value) %>% rename(Lineages = V4)
  statistics <- data_filtered %>%
    group_by(Lineages) %>%
    summarise(Count=n(), Mean=mean(V2,na.rm=T), SD=sd(V2,na.rm=T),
              Median=median(V2,na.rm=T), IQR=IQR(V2,na.rm=T),
              Min=min(V2,na.rm=T), Max=max(V2,na.rm=T), .groups='drop')
  make_dt(statistics, paste0("stats_", case_value))
}

create_scatter_plot <- function(df, category_value, value_col, y_axis_label, plot_title) {
    data_filtered <- df %>% filter(Functional_Category == category_value)
    p <- ggplot(data_filtered, aes(x = Lineages, y = .data[[value_col]], color = Lineages)) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
        geom_jitter(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.25) +
        scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
        labs(x = "", y = y_axis_label, title = plot_title) +
        theme_pubr() +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")
    if (value_col == 'Count') {
        p <- p + scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(x) unique(floor(pretty(x))))
    }
    if (nrow(data_filtered) > 0 && length(unique(data_filtered$Lineages)) >= 2) {
        stat.test <- tryCatch({
            data_filtered %>% dunn_test(as.formula(paste(value_col, "~ Lineages")), p.adjust.method = "BH")
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.null(stat.test) && nrow(stat.test) > 0) {
            stat.test <- stat.test %>% add_xy_position(x = "Lineages", step.increase = 0.08)
            p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label="p.adj.signif", tip.length=0.01, hide.ns=TRUE, size=3.5)
        }
    }
    return(p)
}

# ------------- DATA LOADING -------------
# COG
datos_cog <- read.table(params$cog_file, sep="\t", dec=".", header=F, fill=T, stringsAsFactors=F, quote="", col.names=paste0("V",1:5))
datos_cog$V2 <- sapply(strsplit(datos_cog$V2, "_"), `[`, 1)
colnames(datos_cog) <- c("Lineages","genome","Functional_Category","Count","Percentage")
datos_cog$Lineages[is.na(datos_cog$Lineages) | datos_cog$Lineages == ""] <- "NA"
datos_cog <- datos_cog %>% filter(!is.na(Lineages) & Lineages != "")
datos_cog$Functional_Category[datos_cog$Functional_Category == "" | datos_cog$Functional_Category == "NaN"] <- "NA"
datos_cog$sequences <- paste(datos_cog$Lineages, datos_cog$genome, sep="_")
# Use the real Count values from count_annot.py, not row-counts
datos_cog$Count <- as.integer(datos_cog$Count)
datos_cog <- datos_cog %>%
  group_by(sequences) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()
datos_cog$Percentage <- as.numeric(datos_cog$Percentage)
datos_cog1 <- datos_cog
lvl_cogs <- c("A","B","C","D","E","F","G","H","I","J","K","L","M","N","O","P","Q","S","T","U","V","NA")
datos_cog1$Functional_Category <- factor(datos_cog1$Functional_Category, levels = lvl_cogs)

# Dynamic color assignment for non-MTBC lineages
all_lineages <- unique(c(as.character(datos_cog$Lineages)))
unknown_lineages <- setdiff(all_lineages, names(colors))
if (length(unknown_lineages) > 0) {
  extra_cols <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unknown_lineages))
  names(extra_cols) <- unknown_lineages
  colors <- c(colors, extra_cols)
}

# Mycobrowser — may be empty for non-MTBC organisms
has_mycobrowser_data <- file.exists(params$myco_file) && file.info(params$myco_file)$size > 10
if (has_mycobrowser_data) {
  myco_content <- tryCatch(readLines(params$myco_file, n=2), error=function(e) "")
  has_mycobrowser_data <- length(myco_content) >= 1 && nchar(myco_content[1]) > 5
}

datos_myco <- if (has_mycobrowser_data) read.table(params$myco_file, sep="\t", dec=".", header=F, fill=T, stringsAsFactors=F, quote="", col.names=paste0("V",1:5)) else data.frame()
if (!has_mycobrowser_data) datos_myco <- data.frame(Lineages=character(), genome=character(), Functional_Category=character(), Count=integer(), Percentage=numeric(), sequences=character())

# Skip the rest of Mycobrowser processing if empty
if (has_mycobrowser_data && nrow(datos_myco) > 0) {
  # original Mycobrowser processing
  datos_myco_orig <- datos_myco  # save raw
} else {
  datos_myco_orig <- data.frame()
}

if (has_mycobrowser_data && nrow(datos_myco) > 0) {
datos_myco$V2 <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(datos_myco$V2), "_"), `[`, 1)
colnames(datos_myco) <- c("Lineages","genome","Functional_Category","Count","Percentage")
datos_myco$Lineages[is.na(datos_myco$Lineages) | datos_myco$Lineages == ""] <- "NA"
datos_myco <- datos_myco %>% filter(!is.na(Lineages) & Lineages != "")
datos_myco$Functional_Category[datos_myco$Functional_Category == "" | datos_myco$Functional_Category == "Unassigned"] <- "NA"
datos_myco$sequences <- paste(datos_myco$Lineages, datos_myco$genome, sep="_")
# Use the real Count values from count_annot.py, not row-counts
datos_myco$Count <- as.integer(datos_myco$Count)
datos_myco <- datos_myco %>%
  group_by(sequences) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()
datos_myco$Percentage <- as.numeric(datos_myco$Percentage)

# H37Rv reference comparison (MTBC-specific)
my_myco <- data.frame(
  lineage = rep("L4",11), genome = rep("H37Rv",11),
  Functional_Category = c("PE/PPE","cell wall and cell processes","conserved hypotheticals",
    "information pathways","insertion seqs and phages","intermediary metabolism and respiration",
    "lipid metabolism","regulatory proteins","unknown","virulence, detoxification, adaptation","NA"),
  count = c(162,766,1042,240,149,936,271,198,15,239,13),
  percentage = c(4.02,19.00,25.85,5.95,3.70,23.22,6.72,4.91,0.37,5.93,0.32)
)
merged_data <- merge(my_myco, datos_myco, by="Functional_Category", all=TRUE)
merged_data$Ratio_Percentage <- (merged_data$Count / merged_data$count) * 100
} else {
  # No Mycobrowser data — create empty placeholders
  merged_data <- data.frame()
}

# Case summary data
data_raw <- read.table(params$summary_file, header=F, sep="\t", col.names=c("V1","V2","V3","ID"), fill=T, stringsAsFactors=F, quote="")
# Use V3 (Sequence = full sample name like "L8_G26689") for ID parsing,
# NOT ID (Lineage = just "L8"). The Lineage column from write_summary
# has no genome info, causing genome=NA and table collapse.
processed_ids <- lapply(data_raw$V3, process_id)
data <- tibble(
  V1=data_raw$V1, V2=data_raw$V2, V3=data_raw$V3,
  V4=sapply(processed_ids, `[`, 1), genome=sapply(processed_ids, `[`, 2))
data <- data %>% filter(!is.na(V4) & V4 != "")
# Dynamic lineage ordering: use MTBC order for known lineages, alphabetical for others
mtbc_order <- rev(c("A4","A3","A2","A1","L10","L9","L6","L5","L4","L3","L2","L7","L1","L8","NA"))
observed_lineages <- unique(as.character(data$V4))
known <- intersect(mtbc_order, observed_lineages)
unknown_lin <- sort(setdiff(observed_lineages, mtbc_order))
order_lineages <- c(unknown_lin, known)  # unknown first, then MTBC order
data$V4 <- factor(data$V4, levels = order_lineages)
data <- data %>% mutate(V4 = factor(V4)) %>% droplevels()

# New data sources
# Rv missing (detailed per-gene)
has_rvmissing <- file.exists(params$rvmissing_file) && file.info(params$rvmissing_file)$size > 0
if (has_rvmissing) {
  rvmissing_raw <- tryCatch(
    read.table(params$rvmissing_file, sep="\t", header=F, fill=T, stringsAsFactors=F, quote=""),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(rvmissing_raw) && ncol(rvmissing_raw) >= 5) {
    # Columns: Prot_Id, Prot_len, Strand, Start, End, [Match_Nt, Num_nt], Sample
    # The last column is the sample name appended by REPORT_INPUTS
    n_cols <- ncol(rvmissing_raw)
    base_names <- c("Prot_Id","Prot_len","Strand","Start","End")
    if (n_cols == 8) {
      colnames(rvmissing_raw) <- c(base_names, "Match_Nt", "Num_nt", "Sample")
    } else if (n_cols >= 6) {
      colnames(rvmissing_raw)[1:5] <- base_names
      colnames(rvmissing_raw)[n_cols] <- "Sample"
    } else {
      colnames(rvmissing_raw)[1:5] <- base_names
    }
    rvmissing_raw$Rv_gene <- sub("_\\d+-\\d+$", "", rvmissing_raw$Prot_Id)
    # Extract lineage from sample name
    if ("Sample" %in% colnames(rvmissing_raw)) {
      rvmissing_raw$Lineage <- sub("_.*", "", rvmissing_raw$Sample)
    }
  } else { has_rvmissing <- FALSE }
}

# Master table
has_mastertable <- file.exists(params$mastertable_file) && file.info(params$mastertable_file)$size > 0
if (has_mastertable) {
  mastertable <- tryCatch(
    read.table(params$mastertable_file, sep="\t", header=T, fill=T, stringsAsFactors=F, quote="", comment.char=""),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(mastertable)) has_mastertable <- FALSE
}

# Pangene Rtab
has_pangene <- file.exists(params$pangene_file) && file.info(params$pangene_file)$size > 0
if (has_pangene) {
  pangene_raw <- tryCatch(
    read.table(params$pangene_file, sep="\t", header=T, fill=T, stringsAsFactors=F, quote=""),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(pangene_raw) || ncol(pangene_raw) < 2) has_pangene <- FALSE
}

# Duplications
has_dups <- file.exists(params$dup_file) && file.info(params$dup_file)$size > 0
if (has_dups) {
  dup_data <- tryCatch(
    read.table(params$dup_file, sep="\t", header=T, fill=T, stringsAsFactors=F, quote=""),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(dup_data)) has_dups <- FALSE
}
```

# Overview {.tabset}

## Dataset Composition

This section provides a general overview of the dataset, showing the distribution of sequences across lineages/groups.

```{r lineage_summary, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=14, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
lineage_summary <- data %>%
  rename(Lineages = V4) %>%
  mutate(Lineages = ifelse(is.na(Lineages) | Lineages == "", "NA", as.character(Lineages))) %>%
  group_by(Lineages) %>%
  summarise(Count = n_distinct(V3), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
  mutate(
    Frequency = Count / sum(Count),
    ymax = cumsum(Frequency),
    ymin = c(0, head(ymax, n=-1)),
    labelPosition = (ymax + ymin) / 2,
    label = paste0(Lineages, "\n", round(Frequency*100, 1), "%")
  )

plot_counts <- ggplot(lineage_summary, aes(x = reorder(Lineages, -Count), y = Count, fill = Lineages)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  labs(title = "Number of Unique CDS per Lineage", x = "Lineage", y = "Count") +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  expand_limits(y = max(lineage_summary$Count) * 1.1)

plot_donut <- ggplot(lineage_summary, aes(ymax=ymax, ymin=ymin, xmax=4, xmin=3, fill=Lineages)) +
  geom_rect() +
  geom_label_repel(aes(x=4, y=labelPosition, label=label), size=3, show.legend=F,
                   segment.size=0.5, segment.color="grey50", nudge_x=1) +
  coord_polar(theta="y") + xlim(c(2, 5.5)) + theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors) +
  labs(title="Lineage Distribution (%)") +
  theme(legend.position="none", plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5))

ggarrange(plot_counts, plot_donut, ncol=2, widths=c(0.6, 0.4))
```

## Sample Quality Overview

Per-sample summary of total CDS, correction rates, and missing reference genes.

```{r sample_quality, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
quality_data <- data %>%
  select(V1, V2, V4, genome) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = V1, values_from = V2, values_fn = first) %>%
  mutate(
    Lineage = as.character(V4),
    Genome = genome,
    Total_CDS = as.integer(total_cds),
    Case2_perfect = as.integer(case2),
    Case3_mismatch = as.integer(case3),
    Case4_corrected = as.integer(case4),
    Case1_kept = as.integer(case1_kept),
    Case1_removed = as.integer(case1_removed),
    Rv_missing = as.integer(rv_missing),
    Pct_perfect = round(100 * Case2_perfect / Total_CDS, 1),
    Pct_corrected = round(100 * (Case3_mismatch + Case4_corrected) / Total_CDS, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Lineage, Genome, Total_CDS, Case2_perfect, Case3_mismatch, Case4_corrected,
         Case1_kept, Case1_removed, Rv_missing, Pct_perfect, Pct_corrected) %>%
  arrange(Lineage, Genome)

make_dt(quality_data, "sample_quality_overview")
```

## CDS Correction Summary

```{r cds_correction_summary, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
correction_data <- data %>%
  filter(V1 %in% c("case4","case2","case3","rv_missing")) %>%
  mutate(CorrectionStatus = case_when(
    V1 %in% c("case4","rv_missing") ~ "Corrected by AMAP",
    V1 %in% c("case2","case3") ~ "Matched Reference",
    TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  group_by(V4, CorrectionStatus) %>%
  summarise(TotalCDS=sum(V2), .groups='drop') %>%
  group_by(V4) %>%
  mutate(Percentage=TotalCDS/sum(TotalCDS),
         Label=if_else(Percentage>0.05, scales::percent(Percentage, accuracy=0.1), "")) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(correction_data, aes(x=V4, y=TotalCDS, fill=CorrectionStatus)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label=Label), position=position_fill(vjust=0.5), size=3.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent) +
  labs(title="Corrected vs. Uncorrected CDS per Lineage", x="Lineage", y="Percentage", fill="Status") +
  theme_pubr() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))
```

## Missing Reference Genes (Rv) {.tabset}

Reference genes absent from the Bakta annotation and recovered by AMAP.

### Heatmap

Which Rv genes are missing in which lineages? Darker = missing in more genomes of that lineage.

```{r rvmissing_heatmap, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=12, fig.width=14, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (has_rvmissing) {
  # Count how many genomes are missing each Rv gene, broken down by lineage
  rv_counts <- rvmissing_raw %>%
    group_by(Rv_gene) %>%
    summarise(n_missing = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    arrange(desc(n_missing))
  
  # Show top 50 most frequently missing genes
  top_missing <- head(rv_counts, 50)
  
  # If we have lineage info, show stacked bars by lineage
  if ("Lineage" %in% colnames(rvmissing_raw)) {
    rv_by_lineage <- rvmissing_raw %>%
      filter(Rv_gene %in% top_missing$Rv_gene) %>%
      count(Rv_gene, Lineage)
    
    p <- ggplot(rv_by_lineage, aes(x = reorder(Rv_gene, -n, FUN=sum), y = n, fill = Lineage)) +
      geom_col() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(title = "Top 50 Most Frequently Missing Reference Genes",
           x = "Reference Gene", y = "Number of Genomes Missing This Gene") +
      theme_pubr()
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(top_missing, aes(x = reorder(Rv_gene, n_missing), y = n_missing)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#3da68d") +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(title = "Top 50 Most Frequently Missing Reference Genes",
           x = "Reference Gene", y = "Number of Genomes Missing This Gene") +
      theme_pubr()
  }
  print(p)
} else {
  cat("No Rv missing data available.\n")
}
```

### Full Table

```{r rvmissing_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (has_rvmissing) {
  rv_summary <- rvmissing_raw %>%
    group_by(Rv_gene) %>%
    summarise(
      Times_Missing = n(),
      Avg_Length_bp = round(mean(as.numeric(End) - as.numeric(Start), na.rm=T)),
      Lineages_Affected = if ("Lineage" %in% colnames(rvmissing_raw))
        paste(sort(unique(Lineage)), collapse=", ") else "N/A",
      .groups = 'drop') %>%
    arrange(desc(Times_Missing))
  make_dt(rv_summary, "rv_missing_genes")
} else {
```

# Pangenome Analysis {.tabset}

Gene presence/absence across samples based on pangene analysis.

## Core vs Accessory Genes

```{r pangene_core, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=12, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (has_pangene) {
  # Rtab is a presence/absence matrix: gene × sample
  gene_names <- pangene_raw[, 1]
  pa_matrix <- as.matrix(pangene_raw[, -1])
  
  n_samples <- ncol(pa_matrix)
  gene_freq <- rowSums(pa_matrix > 0)
  
  gene_class <- case_when(
    gene_freq == n_samples ~ "Core (100%)",
    gene_freq >= 0.95 * n_samples ~ "Soft core (≥95%)",
    gene_freq >= 0.15 * n_samples ~ "Shell (15-95%)",
    TRUE ~ "Cloud (<15%)"
  )
  
  class_counts <- data.frame(Category = gene_class) %>%
    count(Category) %>%
    mutate(
      Category = factor(Category, levels=c("Core (100%)","Soft core (≥95%)","Shell (15-95%)","Cloud (<15%)")),
      pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
      label = paste0(n, " (", pct, "%)")
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(class_counts, aes(x=Category, y=n, fill=Category)) +
    geom_col(show.legend=FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label=label), vjust=-0.3, size=4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("Core (100%)"="#2c7bb6","Soft core (≥95%)"="#abd9e9",
                                "Shell (15-95%)"="#fdae61","Cloud (<15%)"="#d7191c")) +
    labs(title=paste0("Pangenome Composition (", n_samples, " samples, ", nrow(pangene_raw), " gene families)"),
         x="", y="Gene Families") +
    theme_pubr() +
    expand_limits(y=max(class_counts$n)*1.12)
  print(p)
  
} else {
  cat("No pangene data available.\n")
}
```

## Gene Frequency Spectrum

```{r pangene_spectrum, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=12, fig.height=6, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (has_pangene) {
  freq_df <- data.frame(frequency = gene_freq)
  
  p <- ggplot(freq_df, aes(x=frequency)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth=1, fill="#3da68d", color="white") +
    labs(title="Gene Frequency Spectrum", x="Number of Samples", y="Gene Families") +
    theme_pubr() +
    geom_vline(xintercept=n_samples, linetype="dashed", color="red") +
    annotate("text", x=n_samples-0.5, y=Inf, label="Core", hjust=1, vjust=1.5, color="red")
  print(p)
} else {
  cat("No pangene data available.\n")
}
```

## Presence/Absence Heatmap

```{r pangene_heatmap, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=10, fig.width=14, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (has_pangene && ncol(pa_matrix) >= 2 && nrow(pa_matrix) >= 2) {
  # Show only shell + cloud genes (variable genes are more interesting)
  variable_idx <- which(gene_freq < n_samples & gene_freq >= 1)
  if (length(variable_idx) > 200) {
    # Sample top 200 most variable
    variable_idx <- variable_idx[order(abs(gene_freq[variable_idx] - n_samples/2))][1:200]
  }
  if (length(variable_idx) >= 2) {
    mat <- pa_matrix[variable_idx, , drop=FALSE]
    rownames(mat) <- gene_names[variable_idx]
    tryCatch({
      pheatmap(mat, color=c("white","#3da68d"), legend_breaks=c(0,1),
               legend_labels=c("Absent","Present"),
               show_rownames=(nrow(mat)<=60), fontsize_row=6, fontsize_col=8,
               main="Variable Gene Presence/Absence", border_color=NA,
               clustering_distance_rows="binary", clustering_distance_cols="binary")
    }, error = function(e) cat("Could not generate heatmap.\n"))
  } else {
    cat("Fewer than 2 variable genes — no heatmap needed.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No pangene data available or too few samples.\n")
}
```

# AMAP CDS Stats {.tabset}

Detailed breakdown of the CDS-correction cases identified by AMAP.

**Classification:**

- **Case 1 keep:** CDS missing from the reference — potentially real novel genes
- **Case 1 remove:** CDS falsely introduced by Bakta, absent from reference
- **Case 2:** Perfect coordinate match with reference
- **Case 3:** Same start/end but containing mismatches
- **Case 4:** Coordinates corrected by AMAP
- **Missing Genes:** Reference genes recovered by AMAP (not annotated by Bakta)

## Boxplot
```{r cds_boxplot, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=5, fig.width=14, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
counts <- data %>% group_by(V4, V1) %>% summarise(n=n(), y_pos=max(V2)+1, .groups='drop')

valid_groups <- data %>%
  group_by(V1) %>% summarise(n_groups=n_distinct(V4), .groups='drop') %>%
  filter(n_groups > 1) %>% pull(V1)

stat.test.cds <- NULL
if (length(valid_groups) > 0) {
  stat.test.cds <- tryCatch({
    data %>% filter(V1 %in% valid_groups) %>% group_by(V1) %>%
      dunn_test(V2 ~ V4, p.adjust.method="BH") %>%
      add_xy_position(x="V4", scales="free_y", step.increase=0.08)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

p <- ggplot(data, aes(x=V4, y=V2, color=V4)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, fill=NA) +
  geom_point(position=position_jitter(width=0.2), alpha=0.2) +
  geom_text(data=counts, aes(x=V4, y=y_pos, label=n, color=V4), position=position_dodge(width=0.75), size=3) +
  facet_wrap(~V1, scales="free_y", ncol=4) +
  theme_pubr() + labs(x="", y="Number of CDS") +
  scale_color_manual(values=colors) +
  theme(legend.position="none", axis.text.x=element_text(size=9.5))

if (!is.null(stat.test.cds) && nrow(stat.test.cds) > 0) {
  p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test.cds, label="p.adj.signif", tip.length=0.01, hide.ns=TRUE, size=2)
}
print(p)
```

## Violinplot

```{r cds_violin, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=5, fig.width=14, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x=V4, y=V2, color=V4)) +

  geom_text(data=means, aes(x=V4, y=y_pos, label=round(mean_value,2), color=V4), size=3) +
  facet_wrap(~V1, scales="free_y", ncol=4) + theme_pubr() +
  labs(x="", y="Number of CDS") + scale_color_manual(values=colors) +
  theme(legend.position="none", axis.text.x=element_text(size=9.5))
print(p)
```

*Report generated by [AMAP](https://github.com/PathoGenOmics-Lab/AMAP) v1.0.0 on `r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`.*
